title: Green System Engine Driven Pump — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the green system engine driven pump from the accessory gearbox, with the depressurisation proof, the case drain sampling step and the drive shaft shear section examination.

sections.purpose: This task removes the green system engine driven pump from the accessory gearbox and takes the case drain sample that the contamination assessment depends on.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the green system depressurised and the reservoir locked out. Confirm zero pressure at the gauge, not at the panel indication; a residual accumulator charge will still inject. The case drain sample must be taken before the line is broken, because the debris that matters settles in the line and will be lost if the line is drained first. Two persons are needed at the pylon.
sections.procedure: 1. Depressurise the green system and lock out the reservoir. WARNING: HYDRAULIC FLUID UNDER PRESSURE CAN CAUSE AN INJECTION INJURY. CONFIRM ZERO PRESSURE AT THE GAUGE BEFORE ANY JOINT IS OPENED. 2. Open the pylon fairings and get access at zones 433 and 443, and at the main gear bay in zone 721. 3. Take a case drain sample through the sampling point and label it with the aircraft, the engine position and the date. 4. Disconnect the pressure, suction and case drain lines and cap each one immediately. CAUTION: CAP EVERY LINE AS IT IS DISCONNECTED. AN OPEN LINE WILL INGEST DEBRIS FROM THE PYLON. 5. Release the loop clamps AGS207234-50 on the inboard pipe FJO107150-27 and move the pipe clear. 6. Disconnect the left-hand depressurisation solenoid BE759984-33 electrical connector. 7. Support the pump and remove the gearbox mounting nuts. 8. Withdraw the pump from the gearbox pad, keeping it square until the drive shaft is clear. 9. Examine the drive shaft shear section for twist, scoring or partial shear and record what you find. 10. Check the pad seal face for fretting. 11. Where fitted, check the non-return valve kit D2910110297925 and the right-hand actuator DU841059-74 for external leakage. 12. Cap the gearbox pad.
sections.close_out: Put the pump in the transit container with all ports capped and the case drain sample attached. Send the sample to the fluid analysis laboratory within the time given in the standard practice. Record the removal, the drive shaft condition and the sample reference in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the case drain sampling point exists only on aircraft post MOD-131570

safety_precautions: Confirm zero pressure at the gauge before any joint is opened.
Wear eye protection and gloves rated for phosphate ester fluid.
Cap every line as it is disconnected.
